mapper.select: SELECT lr.*, l.name AS lab_name, u.real_name AS user_name FROM lab_reservation lr LEFT JOIN lab_room l ON lr.lab_id = l.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON lr.user_id = u.id WHERE lr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_reservation(lab_id, user_id, reserve_date, time_slot, purpose, status) VALUES(#{labId}, #{userId}, #{reserveDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{purpose}, #{status})
